name: Skin of Sweet Rum
summary: A Skin of Sweet Rum is a specialized liquor sourced from the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. It is sought after by Barkeep Daniels in Lakeshire, who is desperate to keep his tavern stocked while Blackrock orcs cut off Redridge from regular trade routes.

sections.title: A Rare Comfort for Lakeshire
sections.body: In the war-weary town of Lakeshire, tavern supplies are running dangerously low. The Blackrock orc invasion has choked the supply roads leading into the Redridge Mountains, leaving Barkeep Daniels scrambling to quench the thirst of beleaguered town guards and refugees. To restock his depleted shelves, Daniels sends travelers across the kingdom to gather regional specialties, including a waterskin filled with the distinctive sweet rum brewed and served in Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn.

faq.q: Where can I find a Skin of Sweet Rum?
faq.answer: A Skin of Sweet Rum can be purchased directly from the innkeeper or barkeep at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, situated in Elwynn Forest.
Barkeep Daniels, the proprietor of the tavern in Lakeshire, requests a skin of Sweet Rum alongside several other regional brews to restock his depleted supply during the quest Dry Times.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire running out of liquor?
aliases: why are they out of booze
faq.answer: The sudden escalation of the Blackrock orc invasion in Redridge has severed trade lines and delayed shipments into town. With normal merchant wagons unable to safely traverse the roads, local stocks are nearly empty.

faq.q: What other spirits are needed alongside the rum?
faq.answer: Alongside the Skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire, Barkeep Daniels also needs a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Westfall, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind City, and a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire.

angles.text: Procuring this rum highlights the logistical strain the Blackrock orc invasion has put on the small settlements defending the eastern borders of the kingdom of Stormwind.
